description: This source file defines a custom exception class 'SavingsAccountBlockedException' used within the savings account portfolio module of Apache Fineract. It extends a generic domain rule exception and signals that transactions are not allowed on blocked accounts.

classes.name: SavingsAccountBlockedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that operations are blocked on a specific savings account.

methods.name: SavingsAccountBlockedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific account ID and a relevant error message.
